boss.PASS_meaning: Source-frame visual screening only; no new production/release approval. Actual Main target contact/timing not signed off.
coverage_limits: Group A: 12 packs, all eight views and role overviews; full movement/attack phases in all eight directions for six packs, E/S/N for six packs. Other intermediate phases unreviewed.
Group B: all source-frame role/view sheets and enlarged selected locomotion; actual Main timing/contact/physical support not approved.
Group C: all existing role/view source phases in eight packs; actual Main target timing, flight altitude and weight transfer not approved.

actors.name: 불신의 시어
reasons: Single central red eye, teeth, crown and red eye-stalk silhouette match the source; the floating eyeball anatomy is retained.
S exposes the central eye/front mouth; N shows the back mantle. Side and rear-quarter stalk silhouettes change with camera direction.
Floating movement uses changing body tilt and independently curved eye-stalk poses rather than foot walking; ground-paw alternation is not applicable.
Attack spreads/leans the eye-stalk cluster, recoil pulls it back, and idle is restrained. No obvious detached part, hard cutoff or collapsed body appeared in the reviewed regions.

actors.name: 살라흐
reasons: Runtime RUN falls back to three WALK poses. Enlarged E/S/W/NE hoof sequences show steps, but which anatomical hoof takes the opposite support and the contact duration are not sufficiently established for mythic locomotion approval.

Windup and sweep exist, but the S/front poleaxe sweeps mostly laterally across the body. Real forward target contact at the marker requires a timed Main/target review; no contact PASS is inferred from the pose name.

actors.name: 샌드 웜

A burrowing/anchored-body interpretation is used. The base stays at the source plane while the neck changes compression and bend; biped/quadruped foot support is not applicable.
Attack compresses/thrusts the mouth, hit retracts it and death progressively slumps. No obvious region cutoff or disconnected core was visible in the examined source frames.
